holder-quote: Grand Mage Esiela was staring. Ulyse grinned around his parasol. He bowed slightly her way.
effect-quote: Arrows made of magical sand rose out of the ground and shot in an arc at the [Archers] and [Mages]. Thousands of them. The low-level spell scaled up wonderfully. And the spell caught the other [Mages] off-guard.
